bounded_ssh_reconnect_20261113.duplicate_launch: A failed connect delivers no command, and the unit launch keeps its fixed job path

No live SSH interruption has exercised the reconnect yet
not_repeated: a connection lost after the command was sent
any exit status of a remote command

float32_esmc_load_20261113.cause: The ESM SDK casts ESMC parameters and buffers to bfloat16 when it loads off CPU; the fp32 producer's cast to float32 keeps the truncated values

corrections: The two fp32 embedding commands of phase3.py replace the ESM SDK loader inside their own process: the model is loaded on CPU, where the SDK keeps float32, and then moved to the requested device; a load that is not a float32 ESMC model is refused
limits: The producer run directly on CUDA outside these two commands still loads through the SDK
The CPU-side load peaks at about 3.1 GiB of host memory
No CUDA run of the corrected load exists yet; check C9 tests it on the pod

fold0_units_after_g2_20261114.classification: Execution-only change under A2-GOV-7 class (a), approved by the maintainer on 2026-11-14
corrections: The coordinator writes the session's hardware profile into the fold request and its worker template and refuses a reviewed request that names another; the runtime gate of every remote unit requires an approved Runpod profile equal to the one the session's probe qualified

For Runpod profiles the lane batch samples its own container's cgroup (memory in use without inactive file cache, swap and CPU time; unified hierarchy or container-scoped v1 mounts) and records the scope; a container that cannot be metered is measured machine-wide with the reason recorded; a dedicated machine is measured as before

Before each closeout inventory the coordinator copies and verifies a pending transfer, uploads the acknowledgment and has the pod's execution record accept it under its own lock; an interrupted unit without a transfer request gets one first
A fresh pass is refused before allocation when its fold primary root, mirror or state root holds files; a recovering session and a resume are exempt
limits: The acknowledgment needs a reachable pod and more than 30 seconds before the session deadline
No live session has exercised the acknowledgment or a resume yet
The recorded lane count does not change dispatch: the fold queue runs one unit at a time
The container telemetry has not run on a live pod yet
